name: byted-audio-continuity
description: Check and repair audio continuity after trimming, splitting, reordering, or retiming audible clips, when cuts produce clicks, abrupt noise changes, or distracting gaps, or when source audio overlaps background music and needs balancing. Use for affected audio boundaries even when smoothing was not explicitly requested. Use the cloud editing controls exposed by the current project environment. Skip visual-only changes with unchanged audio. Does not cover general denoising, music selection, source separation, or visual transitions.
